content: From 1980 until 1995, no one was safe from the dark wit of Gary Larson, not even Mickey Mouse. For 15 years, while he was publishing his beloved single-panel comic strip The Far Side, Larson satirized just about everything, including popular culture. And while Disney didn’t own Marvel, Star Wars, the Muppets, and so many other brands back then, the company was still a huge target that Larson took aim at several times.
